hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدُ بْنُ مُسَرْهَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُمَرَعَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَهُ شَيْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ يَبِيتُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ إِلَّا وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musaddad bin Masarhad], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Sa'id] dari ['Ubaidullah], telah menceritakan kepadaku [Nafi'] dari [Abdullah bin Umar] dari Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam, beliau berkata: "Tidaklah hak seorang muslim yang memiliki sesuatu yang diwasiatkan untuk bermalam selama dua malam melainkan wasiatnya telah tertulis di sisinya."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musaddad bin Masarhad], narrated to us [Yahya bin Sa'id] from ['Ubaidullah], narrated to me [Nafi'] from [Abdullah bin Umar] from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, he said: "It is not the right of a Muslim who has something to bequeath to spend two nights except that his will is written beside him."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musaddad bin Masarhad], 私たちに語った [Yahya bin Sa'id] から ['Ubaidullah], 私に語った [Nafi'] から [Abdullah bin Umar] から the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, 彼は言った: "It is 〜ない the 権利 の a ムスリム 誰 〜した something へ 遺贈する へ 費やす 二 nights except その his 遺言 is written beside him."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musaddad bin Masarhad], 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya bin Sa'id] 부터 ['Ubaidullah], 나에게 전했다 [Nafi'] 부터 [Abdullah bin Umar] 부터 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 그는 말했다: "It is ~아니다 the 권리 의 a 무슬림 누구 ~했다 something 에게 유증하다 에게 지출하다 둘 nights except 그 his 유언 is written beside him."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musaddad bin Masarhad], 向我们讲述 [Yahya bin Sa'id] 从 ['Ubaidullah], 向我讲述 [Nafi'] 从 [Abdullah bin Umar] 从 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 他说: "It is 不 the 权利 的 a 穆斯林 谁 已 something 向 遗赠 向 花费 二 nights except 那 his 遗嘱 is written beside him."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musaddad bin Masarhad], nous a raconté [Yahya bin Sa'id] de ['Ubaidullah], m'a raconté [Nafi'] de [Abdullah bin Umar] de the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, il a dit: "It is pas the droit de a musulman qui a something à léguer à dépenser deux nights except cela his testament is written beside him."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musaddad bin Masarhad], hat uns erzählt [Yahya bin Sa'id] von ['Ubaidullah], hat mir erzählt [Nafi'] von [Abdullah bin Umar] von the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, er sagte: "It is nicht the Recht von a Muslim wer hat something zu vermachen zu ausgeben zwei nights except das his Testament is written beside him."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musaddad bin Masarhad], ci ha narrato [Yahya bin Sa'id] da ['Ubaidullah], mi ha narrato [Nafi'] da [Abdullah bin Umar] da the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, disse: "It is non the diritto di a musulmano chi ha something a lasciare in eredità a spendere due nights except quello his testamento is written beside him."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْمَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دِينَارًا وَلَا دِرْهَمًا وَلَا بَعِيرًا وَلَا شَاةً وَلَا أَوْصَى بِشَيْءٍ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musaddad] dan [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], mereka berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu Mu'awiyah] dari [Al A'masy] dari [Abu Wail], dari [Masruq] dari [Aisyah], ia berkata; Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam tidak meninggalkan dinar, dirham, unta serta kambing dan beliau tidak berwasiat dengan sesuatupun.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musaddad] and [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], they said; narrated to us [Abu Mu'awiyah] from [Al A'masy] from [Abu Wail], from [Masruq] from [Aisyah], he said; The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, did not leave a dinar, a dirham, a camel, or a sheep, and he did not bequeath anything.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musaddad] そして [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], 彼らは言った; 私たちに語った [Abu Mu'awiyah] から [Al A'masy] から [Abu Wail], から [Masruq] から [Aisyah], 彼は言った; アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, した 〜ない leave a ディーナール, a ディルハム, a ラクダ, または a 羊, そして he した 〜ない 遺贈する anything.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musaddad] 그리고 [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], 그들은 말했다; 우리에게 전했다 [Abu Mu'awiyah] 부터 [Al A'masy] 부터 [Abu Wail], 부터 [Masruq] 부터 [Aisyah], 그는 말했다; 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 했다 ~아니다 leave a 디나르, a 디르함, a 낙타, 또는 a 양, 그리고 he 했다 ~아니다 유증하다 anything.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musaddad] 和 [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], 他们说; 向我们讲述 [Abu Mu'awiyah] 从 [Al A'masy] 从 [Abu Wail], 从 [Masruq] 从 [Aisyah], 他说; 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 做了 不 leave a 第纳尔, a 迪拉姆, a 骆驼, 或 a 羊, 和 he 做了 不 遗赠 anything.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musaddad] et [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], ils ont dit; nous a raconté [Abu Mu'awiyah] de [Al A'masy] de [Abu Wail], de [Masruq] de [Aisyah], il a dit; Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, a fait pas leave a dinar, a dirham, a chameau, ou a mouton, et he a fait pas léguer anything.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musaddad] und [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], sie sagten; hat uns erzählt [Abu Mu'awiyah] von [Al A'masy] von [Abu Wail], von [Masruq] von [Aisyah], er sagte; Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, tat nicht leave a Dinar, a Dirham, a Kamel, oder a Schaf, und he tat nicht vermachen anything.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musaddad] e [Muhammad bin Al 'Ala`], dissero; ci ha narrato [Abu Mu'awiyah] da [Al A'masy] da [Abu Wail], da [Masruq] da [Aisyah], disse; Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, fece non leave a dinaro, a dirham, a cammello, o a pecora, e he fece non lasciare in eredità anything.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَمَرِضَ مَرَضًا قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ بِمَكَّةَ ثُمَّ اتَّفَقَا أَشْفَى فِيهِ فَعَادَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي مَالًا كَثِيرًا وَلَيْسَ يَرِثُنِي إِلَّا ابْنَتِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِالثُّلُثَيْنِ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَبِالشَّطْرِ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَبِالثُّلُثِ قَالَ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَتْرُكَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَدَعَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ وَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً إِلَّا أُجِرْتَ بِهَا حَتَّى اللُّقْمَةُ تَرْفَعُهَا إِلَى فِي امْرَأَتِكِ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَخَلَّفُ عَنْ هِجْرَتِي قَالَ إِنَّكَ إِنْ تُخَلَّفْ بَعْدِي فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا تُرِيدُ بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ لَا تَزْدَادُ بِهِ إِلَّا رِفْعَةً وَدَرَجَةً لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تُخَلَّفَ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لِأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ وَلَا تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ لَكِنْ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ بْنُ خَوْلَةَ يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ مَاتَ بِمَكَّةَ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], serta [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], mereka berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sufyan] dari [Az Zuhri], dari [Amir bin Sa'd], dari [ayahnya], ia berkata; Sa'd terkena suatu penyakit, Ibnu Abu Khalaf berkata; di Mekkah. Kemudian lafazh mereka sama; hampir meninggal karena penyakit tersebut, kemudian Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam menjenguknya, lalu ia berkata; wahai Rasulullah, sesungguhnya saya memiliki harta yang banyak, dan tidak ada yang mewarisiku selain anak perempuanku, apakah aku boleh bersedekah dengan dua pertiga? Beliau bersabda: "Tidak." Ia berkata; setengah? Beliau bersabda: "Tidak." Ia berkata; sepertiga? Beliau bersabda: "Ya, sepertiga. Dan sepertiga adalah banyak. Sesungguhnya engkau meninggalkan para pewarismu dalam keadaan kaya adalah lebih baik daripada engkau meninggalkan mereka dalam keadaan kekurangan, mereka meminta-minta kepada manusia. Dan sesungguhnya tidaklah engkau berinfak dengan suatu nafkah melainkan engkau diberi pahala karenanya, hingga suapan yang engkau berikan kepada isterimu." Aku katakan; wahai Rasulullah, apakah aku akan tinggal di Mekkah? Beliau berkata: "Sesungguhnya seandainya engkau tertinggal setelahku kemudian engkau beramal shalih dengan mengharapkan wajah Allah niscaya engkau pasti akan bertambah tinggi derajatmu, kemungkinan engkau akan berumur panjang hingga orang-orang mengambil manfaat dengan keberadaanmu, dan orang yang lain akan mendapatkan madharat." Kemudian beliau berkata kepada para sahabatnya: "Ya Allah, sempurnakanlah hijrah para sahabatku, dan jangan Engkau kembalikan mereka kepada kekafiran, akan tetapi Sa'd bin Khaulah akan meninggal di Mekkah." Beliau merasa kasihan terhadapnya.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], and [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], they said; narrated to us [Sufyan] from [Az Zuhri], from [Amir bin Sa'd], from [his father], he said; Sa'd was afflicted with an illness, Ibnu Abu Khalaf said; in Mecca. Then their wording was the same; he was almost dying from that illness, then the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, visited him, and he said; O Messenger of Allah, indeed I have much wealth, and none will inherit me except my daughter; may I give two-thirds in charity? He said: 'No.' He said; half? He said: 'No.' He said; one-third? He said: 'Yes, one-third. And one-third is much. Indeed, leaving your heirs rich is better than leaving them in need, begging from people. And indeed, you do not spend any expenditure except that you are rewarded for it, even the morsel you put in your wife's mouth.' I said; O Messenger of Allah, will I remain in Mecca? He said: 'Indeed, if you remain after me and then do righteous deeds seeking the Face of Allah, you will certainly rise in rank; it is likely you will live long until people benefit from your presence, and other people will be harmed.' Then he said to his Companions: 'O Allah, complete the Hijrah of my Companions, and do not return them to disbelief; but Sa'd bin Khaulah will die in Mecca.' He felt pity for him.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], そして [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], 彼らは言った; 私たちに語った [Sufyan] から [Az Zuhri], から [Amir bin Sa'd], から [his father], 彼は言った; Sa'd was 罹った とともに an 病気, Ibnu Abu Khalaf 言った; 〜に メッカ. Then their 文言 was the 同じ; he was ほとんど dying から その 病気, それから the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, 彼を見舞った, そして 彼は言った; O 使徒 の アッラー, indeed I 持つ 多くの 財産, そして none 遺言 相続する me except my 娘; may I give 三分の二 〜に 施し? 彼は言った: 'No.' 彼は言った; 半分? 彼は言った: 'No.' 彼は言った; 三分の一? 彼は言った: 'Yes, 三分の一. And 三分の一 is 多くの. Indeed, leaving your 相続人たち 裕福な is より良い than leaving them 〜に 困窮, 物乞いをする から 人々. And indeed, you する 〜ない 費やす any 支出 except その you are 報われた 〜のために it, even the 一口 you 入れた your 妻's 口.' 私は言った; O 使徒 の アッラー, 遺言 I 残る 〜に メッカ? 彼は言った: 'Indeed, もし you 残る after me そして それから する 正しい 行い 求めて the 御顔 の アッラー, you 遺言 確かに 高まる 〜に 位階; it is likely you 遺言 長生きする until 人々 利益 から your 存在, そして 他の 人々 遺言 be 害を受ける.' Then 彼は言った へ his 教友たち: 'O アッラー, 完成させる the ヒジュラ の my 教友たち, そして する 〜ない 戻す them へ 不信仰; しかし Sa'd bin Khaulah 遺言 die 〜に メッカ.' He 感じた 同情 〜のために him.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], 그리고 [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], 그들은 말했다; 우리에게 전했다 [Sufyan] 부터 [Az Zuhri], 부터 [Amir bin Sa'd], 부터 [his father], 그는 말했다; Sa'd was 걸렸다 함께 an 병, Ibnu Abu Khalaf 말했다; 에 메카. Then their 문구 was the 같은; he was 거의 dying 부터 그 병, 그러자 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 그를 문병했다, 그리고 그는 말했다; O 메신저 의 알라, indeed I 가지다 많은 재산, 그리고 none 유언 상속하다 me except my 딸; may I give 3분의 2 에 자선? 그는 말했다: 'No.' 그는 말했다; 절반? 그는 말했다: 'No.' 그는 말했다; 3분의 1? 그는 말했다: 'Yes, 3분의 1. And 3분의 1 is 많은. Indeed, leaving your 상속인들 부유한 is 더 나은 than leaving them 에 궁핍, 구걸하는 부터 사람들. And indeed, you 하다 ~아니다 지출하다 any 지출 except 그 you are 보상받았다 위해 it, even the 한 입 you 넣었다 your 아내's 입.' 나는 말했다; O 메신저 의 알라, 유언 I 남다 에 메카? 그는 말했다: 'Indeed, 만약 you 남다 after me 그리고 그러자 하다 의로운 행위 추구하며 the 얼굴 의 알라, you 유언 확실히 높아지다 에 지위; it is likely you 유언 오래 살다 until 사람들 이익 부터 your 존재, 그리고 다른 사람들 유언 be 해를 입다.' Then 그는 말했다 에게 his 동료들: 'O 알라, 완성하다 the 히즈라 의 my 동료들, 그리고 하다 ~아니다 돌아가다 them 에게 불신; 그러나 Sa'd bin Khaulah 유언 die 에 메카.' He 느꼈다 연민 위해 him.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], 和 [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], 他们说; 向我们讲述 [Sufyan] 从 [Az Zuhri], 从 [Amir bin Sa'd], 从 [his father], 他说; Sa'd was 患了 与 an 疾病, Ibnu Abu Khalaf 说; 在 麦加. Then their 措辞 was the 相同; he was 几乎 dying 从 那 疾病, 然后 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 看望了他, 和 他说; O 使者 的 安拉, indeed I 有 多 财产, 和 none 遗嘱 继承 me except my 女儿; may I give 三分之二 在 施舍? 他说: 'No.' 他说; 一半? 他说: 'No.' 他说; 三分之一? 他说: 'Yes, 三分之一. And 三分之一 is 多. Indeed, leaving your 继承人们 富裕 is 更有利 than leaving them 在 困窘, 乞讨 从 人们. And indeed, you 做 不 花费 any 开支 except 那 you are 得到报酬 为了 it, even the 一口 you 放入 your 妻子's 嘴.' 我说; O 使者 的 安拉, 遗嘱 I 留下 在 麦加? 他说: 'Indeed, 如果 you 留下 after me 和 然后 做 善 行为 希求 the 面容 的 安拉, you 遗嘱 肯定 提升 在 品级; it is likely you 遗嘱 长寿 until 人们 受益 从 your 存在, 和 其他 人们 遗嘱 be 受到伤害.' Then 他说 向 his 同伴们: 'O 安拉, 完成 the 迁徙 的 my 同伴们, 和 做 不 返回 them 向 不信; 但是 Sa'd bin Khaulah 遗嘱 die 在 麦加.' He 感到 怜悯 为了 him.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], et [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], ils ont dit; nous a raconté [Sufyan] de [Az Zuhri], de [Amir bin Sa'd], de [his father], il a dit; Sa'd was atteint avec an maladie, Ibnu Abu Khalaf a dit; dans La Mecque. Then their formulation was the même; he was presque dying de cela maladie, puis the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, lui a rendu visite, et il a dit; O Messager de Allah, indeed I avoir beaucoup richesse, et none testament hériter me except my fille; may I give deux tiers dans aumône? Il a dit: 'No.' Il a dit; la moitié? Il a dit: 'No.' Il a dit; un tiers? Il a dit: 'Yes, un tiers. And un tiers is beaucoup. Indeed, leaving your héritiers riches is meilleur than leaving them dans besoin, mendier de gens. And indeed, you faire pas dépenser any dépense except cela you are récompensé pour it, even the bouchée you mise dans your femme's bouche.' j'ai dit; O Messager de Allah, testament I rester dans La Mecque? Il a dit: 'Indeed, si you rester after me et puis faire pieux œuvres recherchant the Face de Allah, you testament certainement s'élever dans rang; it is likely you testament vivre longtemps until gens profiter de your présence, et autre gens testament be lésés.' Then il a dit à his Compagnons: 'O Allah, parfaire the Hégire de my Compagnons, et faire pas ramener them à mécréance; mais Sa'd bin Khaulah testament die dans La Mecque.' He a ressenti pitié pour him.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], und [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], sie sagten; hat uns erzählt [Sufyan] von [Az Zuhri], von [Amir bin Sa'd], von [his father], er sagte; Sa'd was befallen mit an Krankheit, Ibnu Abu Khalaf sagte; in Mekka. Then their Wortlaut was the gleich; he was fasten dying von das Krankheit, dann the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, besuchte ihn, und er sagte; O Gesandter von Allah, indeed I haben viel Vermögen, und none Testament erben me except my Tochter; may I give zwei Drittel in Almosen? Er sagte: 'No.' Er sagte; die Hälfte? Er sagte: 'No.' Er sagte; ein Drittel? Er sagte: 'Yes, ein Drittel. And ein Drittel is viel. Indeed, leaving your Erben reich is besser than leaving them in Not, betteln von Leute. And indeed, you tun nicht ausgeben any Ausgabe except das you are belohnt für it, even the Bissen you gelegt in your Frau's Mund.' ich sagte; O Gesandter von Allah, Testament I bleiben in Mekka? Er sagte: 'Indeed, wenn you bleiben after me und dann tun rechtschaffen Taten suchend the Angesicht von Allah, you Testament sicher aufsteigen in Rang; it is likely you Testament lange leben until Leute Nutzen ziehen von your Anwesenheit, und anderer Leute Testament be geschädigt.' Then er sagte zu his Gefährten: 'O Allah, vollenden the Hidschra von my Gefährten, und tun nicht zurückführen them zu Unglaube; aber Sa'd bin Khaulah Testament die in Mekka.' He empfand Mitleid für him.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], e [Ibnu Abu Khalaf], dissero; ci ha narrato [Sufyan] da [Az Zuhri], da [Amir bin Sa'd], da [his father], disse; Sa'd was colpito con an malattia, Ibnu Abu Khalaf disse; in La La Mecca. Then their formulazione was the stessa; he was quasi dying da quello malattia, poi the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, lo visitò, e disse; O Messaggero di Allah, indeed I avere molto ricchezza, e none testamento ereditare me except my figlia; may I give due terzi in elemosina? Disse: 'No.' Disse; metà? Disse: 'No.' Disse; un terzo? Disse: 'Yes, un terzo. And un terzo is molto. Indeed, leaving your eredi ricchi is migliore than leaving them in bisogno, mendicare da gente. And indeed, you fare non spendere any spesa except quello you are ricompensato per it, even the boccone you messo in your moglie's bocca.' dissi; O Messaggero di Allah, testamento I rimanere in La La Mecca? Disse: 'Indeed, se you rimanere after me e poi fare pio opere cercando the Volto di Allah, you testamento certamente salire in rango; it is likely you testamento vivere a lungo until gente trarre beneficio da your presenza, e altro gente testamento be danneggiati.' Then disse a his Compagni: 'O Allah, completare the Egira di my Compagni, e fare non ricondurre them a miscredenza; ma Sa'd bin Khaulah testamento die in La La Mecca.' He provò pietà per him.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ أَنْ تَصَدَّقَ وَأَنْتَ صَحِيحٌ حَرِيصٌ تَأْمُلُ الْبَقَاءَ وَتَخْشَى الْفَقْرَ وَلَا تُمْهِلَ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَتْ الْحُلْقُومَ قُلْتَ لِفُلَانٍ كَذَا وَلِفُلَانٍ كَذَا وَقَدْ كَانَ لِفُلَانٍ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musaddad], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], telah menceritakan kepada kami ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] dari [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], dari [Abu Hurairah], ia berkata; seseorang berkata kepada Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam; wahai Rasulullah, sedekah apakah yang paling utama? Beliau berkata: "Engkau bersedekah dalam keadaan sehat, bersemangat dan mengharapkan tetap hidup, serta khawatir mengalami kekurangan, dan engkau tidak menunda hingga setelah nyawa telah sampai di tenggorokan engkau mengatakan; untuk Fulan sekian dan untuk Fulan sekian. Dan sungguh harta tersebut telah menjadi milik Fulan."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musaddad], narrated to us [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], narrated to us ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] from [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], from [Abu Hurairah], he said; a man said to the Prophet, peace be upon him; O Messenger of Allah, what charity is most excellent? He said: 'You give charity while you are healthy, eager, hoping to remain alive, and fearing poverty, and you do not delay until after the soul has reached the throat, you say; for so-and-so such-and-such and for so-and-so such-and-such. And indeed that wealth has become the property of so-and-so.'
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musaddad], 私たちに語った [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], 私たちに語った ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] から [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], から [Abu Hurairah], 彼は言った; a 男 言った へ the 預言者, 平和 be upon him; O 使徒 の アッラー, 何 施し is 最も excellent? 彼は言った: 'You 施しをする 〜の間 you are 健康な, 熱心な, hoping へ 残る 生きている, そして 恐れて 貧困, そして you する 〜ない 遅らせる until after the 魂 〜した reached the 喉, you say; 〜のために 某 あれこれ そして 〜のために 某 あれこれ. And indeed その 財産 〜した become the 財産 の 某.'
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musaddad], 우리에게 전했다 [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], 우리에게 전했다 ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] 부터 [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], 부터 [Abu Hurairah], 그는 말했다; a 남자 말했다 에게 the 예언자, 평화 be upon him; O 메신저 의 알라, 무엇 자선 is 가장 excellent? 그는 말했다: 'You 자선을 베풀다 ~동안 you are 건강한, 간절한, hoping 에게 남다 살아 있는, 그리고 두려워하며 빈곤, 그리고 you 하다 ~아니다 미루다 until after the 영혼 ~했다 reached the 목구멍, you say; 위해 아무개 이러저러 그리고 위해 아무개 이러저러. And indeed 그 재산 ~했다 become the 재산 의 아무개.'
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musaddad], 向我们讲述 [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], 向我们讲述 ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] 从 [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], 从 [Abu Hurairah], 他说; a 男人 说 向 the 先知, 和平 be upon him; O 使者 的 安拉, 什么 施舍 is 最 excellent? 他说: 'You 施舍 当 you are 健康, 渴望, hoping 向 留下 活着, 和 害怕 贫穷, 和 you 做 不 拖延 until after the 灵魂 已 reached the 喉咙, you say; 为了 某人 若干 和 为了 某人 若干. And indeed 那 财产 已 become the 财产 的 某人.'
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musaddad], nous a raconté [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], nous a raconté ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] de [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], de [Abu Hurairah], il a dit; a homme a dit à the Prophète, paix be upon him; O Messager de Allah, quoi aumône is le plus excellent? Il a dit: 'You faire l'aumône pendant que you are en bonne santé, ardent, hoping à rester vivant, et craignant pauvreté, et you faire pas retarder until after the âme a reached the gorge, you say; pour untel tant et tant et pour untel tant et tant. And indeed cela richesse a become the bien de untel.'
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musaddad], hat uns erzählt [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], hat uns erzählt ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] von [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], von [Abu Hurairah], er sagte; a Mann sagte zu the Prophet, Frieden be upon him; O Gesandter von Allah, was Almosen is am meisten excellent? Er sagte: 'You Almosen geben während you are gesund, eifrig, hoping zu bleiben lebendig, und fürchtend Armut, und you tun nicht aufschieben until after the Seele hat reached the Kehle, you say; für der und der dies und das und für der und der dies und das. And indeed das Vermögen hat become the Eigentum von der und der.'
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musaddad], ci ha narrato [Abdul Wahid bin Ziyad], ci ha narrato ['Umarah bin Al Qa'qa'] da [Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir], da [Abu Hurairah], disse; a uomo disse a the Profeta, pace be upon him; O Messaggero di Allah, cosa elemosina is più excellent? Disse: 'You fare elemosina mentre you are sano, desideroso, hoping a rimanere vivo, e temendo povertà, e you fare non rimandare until after the anima ha reached the gola, you say; per tizio tanto e tanto e per tizio tanto e tanto. And indeed quello ricchezza ha become the proprietà di tizio.'

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لَأَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ الْمَرْءُ فِي حَيَاتِهِ بِدِرْهَمٍ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Shalih], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], telah mengabarkan kepadaku [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] dari [Syurahbil], dari [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], bahwa Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam berkata: "Sungguh seseorang bersedekah pada waktu hidupnya dengan satu dirham adalah lebih baik baginya daripada ia bersedekah dengan seratus dirham ketika akan meninggal."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Shalih], narrated to us [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], informed me [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] from [Syurahbil], from [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "Indeed, a person giving one dirham in charity during his lifetime is better for him than giving one hundred dirhams in charity when he is about to die."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Shalih], 私たちに語った [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], 私に伝えた [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] から [Syurahbil], から [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], その the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him 言った: "Indeed, a 人 与えること one ディルハム 〜に 施し during his 生涯 is より良い 〜のために him than 与えること one hundred dirhams 〜に 施し 〜のとき he is 〜について へ die."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Shalih], 우리에게 전했다 [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], 나에게 알려 주었다 [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] 부터 [Syurahbil], 부터 [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], 그 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him 말했다: "Indeed, a 사람 주는 것 one 디르함 에 자선 during his 생애 is 더 나은 위해 him than 주는 것 one hundred dirhams 에 자선 ~할 때 he is 에 대해 에게 die."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Shalih], 向我们讲述 [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], 告诉我 [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] 从 [Syurahbil], 从 [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], 那 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him 说: "Indeed, a 人 给予 one 迪拉姆 在 施舍 during his 一生 is 更有利 为了 him than 给予 one hundred dirhams 在 施舍 当 he is 关于 向 die."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Shalih], nous a raconté [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], m'a informé [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] de [Syurahbil], de [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], cela the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him a dit: "Indeed, a personne donner one dirham dans aumône during his vie is meilleur pour him than donner one hundred dirhams dans aumône quand he is au sujet de à die."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Shalih], hat uns erzählt [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], hat mir berichtet [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] von [Syurahbil], von [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], das the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him sagte: "Indeed, a Person Geben one Dirham in Almosen during his Lebenszeit is besser für him than Geben one hundred dirhams in Almosen wenn he is über zu die."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Shalih], ci ha narrato [Ibnu Abu Fudaik], mi ha informato [Ibnu Abi Dzi`b] da [Syurahbil], da [Abu Sa'id Al Khudri], quello the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him disse: "Indeed, a persona dare one dirham in elemosina during his vita is migliore per him than dare one hundred dirhams in elemosina quando he is riguardo a die."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْصَّمَدِ حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُدَّانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ حَدَّثَنِي شَهْرُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً ثُمَّ يَحْضُرُهُمَا الْمَوْتُ فَيُضَارَّانِ فِي الْوَصِيَّةِ فَتَجِبُ لَهُمَا النَّارُقَالَ وَقَرَأَ عَلَيَّ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ مِنْ هَا هُنَا{ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصَى بِهَا أَوْ دَيْنٍ غَيْرَ مُضَارٍّ حَتَّى بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ }قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد هَذَا يَعْنِي الْأَشْعَثَ بْنَ جَابِرٍ جَدَّ نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami ['Abdah bin Abdullah], telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Abdushshamad], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], telah menceritakan kepadaku [Syahr bin Hausyab], bahwa [Abu Hurairah] telah menceritakan kepadanya bahwa Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Sesungguhnya ada seorang laki-laki dan wanita yang beramal dengan ketaatan kepada Allah selama enam puluh tahun kemudian kematian menghampiri mereka berdua, lalu mereka menyulitkan (para pewaris) dalam berwasiat sehingga neraka adalah wajib bagi mereka." Kemudian Abu Hurairah membacakan ayat kepadaku dari sini: "Sesudah dipenuhi wasiat yang dibuat olehnya atau sesudah dibayar hutangnya dengan tidak memberi mudharat (kepada ahli waris) ….." hingga sampai firmanNya: "dan itulah kemenangan yang besar." Abu Daud berkata; orang ini yaitu Al Asy'ats bin Jabir adalah kakek Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.en: Narrated to us ['Abdah bin Abdullah], informed us [Abdushshamad], narrated to us [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], narrated to us [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], narrated to me [Syahr bin Hausyab], that [Abu Hurairah] told him that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, there is a man and a woman who did deeds in obedience to Allah for sixty years, then death came to them both, then they harmed (the heirs) in their will, so Hell became obligatory for them." Then Abu Hurairah recited a verse to me from here: 'After a will that was made by him or after a debt is paid, without harming (the heirs)...' until His statement: 'and that is the great victory.' Abu Dawud said; this man, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather of Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った ['Abdah bin Abdullah], 私たちに伝えた [Abdushshamad], 私たちに語った [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], 私たちに語った [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], 私に語った [Syahr bin Hausyab], その [Abu Hurairah] 彼に語った その the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, 言った: "Indeed, そこ is a 男 そして a 女性 誰 した 行い 〜に 従順 へ アッラー 〜のために 六十 年, それから 死 来た へ them both, それから they 害を受ける (the 相続人たち) 〜に their 遺言, それで 地獄 became 義務 〜のために them." Then Abu Hurairah 朗読した a 節 へ me から ここ: 'After a 遺言 その was 作られた by him または after a 借金 is 支払われた, 〜なしに harming (the 相続人たち)...' until His 御言葉: 'そして その is the 大きな 勝利.' アブー・ダーウードは言った; this 男, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather の Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 ['Abdah bin Abdullah], 우리에게 알려 주었다 [Abdushshamad], 우리에게 전했다 [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], 우리에게 전했다 [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], 나에게 전했다 [Syahr bin Hausyab], 그 [Abu Hurairah] 그에게 전했다 그 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 말했다: "Indeed, 거기 is a 남자 그리고 a 여성 누구 했다 행위 에 순종 에게 알라 위해 육십 년, 그러자 죽음 왔다 에게 them both, 그러자 they 해를 입다 (the 상속인들) 에 their 유언, 그래서 지옥 became 의무 위해 them." Then Abu Hurairah 낭송했다 a 구절 에게 me 부터 여기: 'After a 유언 그 was 만들어졌다 by him 또는 after a 빚 is 지불되었다, 없이 harming (the 상속인들)...' until His 말씀: '그리고 그 is the 위대한 승리.' 아부 다우드가 말했다; this 남자, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather 의 Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 ['Abdah bin Abdullah], 告诉我们 [Abdushshamad], 向我们讲述 [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], 向我们讲述 [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], 向我讲述 [Syahr bin Hausyab], 那 [Abu Hurairah] 告诉他 那 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 说: "Indeed, 那里 is a 男人 和 a 妇女 谁 做了 行为 在 顺从 向 安拉 为了 六十 年, 然后 死亡 来到 向 them both, 然后 they 受到伤害 (the 继承人们) 在 their 遗嘱, 所以 火狱 became 必定 为了 them." Then Abu Hurairah 诵读 a 经文 向 me 从 这里: 'After a 遗嘱 那 was 被立 by him 或 after a 债务 is 被偿还, 没有 harming (the 继承人们)...' until His 话语: '和 那 is the 伟大 胜利.' 艾布·达乌德说; this 男人, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather 的 Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté ['Abdah bin Abdullah], nous a informés [Abdushshamad], nous a raconté [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], nous a raconté [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], m'a raconté [Syahr bin Hausyab], cela [Abu Hurairah] lui a raconté cela the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, a dit: "Indeed, là is a homme et a femme qui a fait œuvres dans obéissance à Allah pour soixante ans, puis mort est venue à them both, puis they lésés (the héritiers) dans their testament, donc Enfer became obligatoire pour them." Then Abu Hurairah a récité a verset à me de ici: 'After a testament cela was fait by him ou after a dette is payée, sans harming (the héritiers)...' until His parole: 'et cela is the grande victoire.' Abou Dawoud a dit; this homme, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather de Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt ['Abdah bin Abdullah], hat uns berichtet [Abdushshamad], hat uns erzählt [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], hat uns erzählt [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], hat mir erzählt [Syahr bin Hausyab], das [Abu Hurairah] hat ihm erzählt das the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, sagte: "Indeed, dort is a Mann und a Frau wer tat Taten in Gehorsam zu Allah für sechzig Jahre, dann Tod kam zu them both, dann they geschädigt (the Erben) in their Testament, also Hölle became verpflichtend für them." Then Abu Hurairah rezitierte a Vers zu me von hier: 'After a Testament das was gemacht by him oder after a Schuld is bezahlt, ohne harming (the Erben)...' until His Aussage: 'und das is the groß Sieg.' Abu Dawud sagte; this Mann, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather von Nashr bin Ali.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato ['Abdah bin Abdullah], ci ha informato [Abdushshamad], ci ha narrato [Nashr bin Ali Al Huddani], ci ha narrato [Al Asy'ats bin Jabir], mi ha narrato [Syahr bin Hausyab], quello [Abu Hurairah] gli ha narrato quello the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, disse: "Indeed, lì is a uomo e a donna chi fece opere in obbedienza a Allah per sessanta anni, poi morte venne a them both, poi they danneggiati (the eredi) in their testamento, quindi Inferno became obbligatorio per them." Then Abu Hurairah recitò a versetto a me da qui: 'After a testamento quello was fatto by him o after a debito is pagato, senza harming (the eredi)...' until His parola: 'e quello is the grande vittoria.' Abu Dawud disse; this uomo, namely Al Asy'ats bin Jabir, is the grandfather di Nashr bin Ali.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُقْرِئُ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي سَالِمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِنِّي أَرَاكَ ضَعِيفًا وَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ لَكَ مَا أُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِي فَلَا تَأَمَّرَنَّ عَلَى اثْنَيْنِ وَلَا تَوَلَّيَنَّ مَالَ يَتِيمٍقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد تَفَرَّدَ بِهِ أَهْلُ مِصْرَ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Al Hasan bin Ali], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], dari ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], dari [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], dari [ayahnya], dari [Abu Dzar], ia berkata; Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda kepadaku: "Wahai Abu Dzar, aku melihat engkau adalah orang yang lemah dan aku mencintai sesuatu untukmu sebagaimana yang aku cintai untuk diriku. Maka janganlah engkau memimpin dua orang dan jangan engkau mengurusi harta anak yatim." Abu Daud berkata; hadits tersebut hanya diriwayatkan penduduk Mesir.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Al Hasan bin Ali], narrated to us [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], narrated to us [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], from ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], from [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], from [his father], from [Abu Dzar], he said; The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a weak man, and I love for you what I love for myself. So do not lead two people, and do not manage the wealth of an orphan." Abu Dawud said; that hadith was only narrated by the people of Egypt.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Al Hasan bin Ali], 私たちに語った [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], 私たちに語った [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], から ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], から [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], から [his father], から [Abu Dzar], 彼は言った; アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）は言った へ me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a 弱い 男, そして I 愛する 〜のために you 何 I 愛する 〜のために 私自身. So する 〜ない 率いる 二 人々, そして する 〜ない 管理する the 財産 の an 孤児." アブー・ダーウードは言った; その hadith was ただ narrated by the 人々 の エジプト.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Al Hasan bin Ali], 우리에게 전했다 [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], 우리에게 전했다 [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], 부터 ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], 부터 [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], 부터 [his father], 부터 [Abu Dzar], 그는 말했다; 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를)께서 말씀하셨다 에게 me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a 약한 남자, 그리고 I 사랑하다 위해 you 무엇 I 사랑하다 위해 나 자신. So 하다 ~아니다 이끌다 둘 사람들, 그리고 하다 ~아니다 관리하다 the 재산 의 an 고아." 아부 다우드가 말했다; 그 hadith was 다만 narrated by the 사람들 의 이집트.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Al Hasan bin Ali], 向我们讲述 [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], 向我们讲述 [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], 从 ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], 从 [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], 从 [his father], 从 [Abu Dzar], 他说; 安拉的使者（愿他平安）说 向 me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a 弱 男人, 和 I 喜爱 为了 you 什么 I 喜爱 为了 我自己. So 做 不 领导 二 人们, 和 做 不 管理 the 财产 的 an 孤儿." 艾布·达乌德说; 那 hadith was 只 narrated by the 人们 的 埃及.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Al Hasan bin Ali], nous a raconté [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], nous a raconté [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], de ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], de [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], de [his father], de [Abu Dzar], il a dit; Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, a dit à me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a faible homme, et I aimer pour you quoi I aimer pour moi-même. So faire pas diriger deux gens, et faire pas gérer the richesse de an orphelin." Abou Dawoud a dit; cela hadith was seulement narrated by the gens de Égypte.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Al Hasan bin Ali], hat uns erzählt [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], hat uns erzählt [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], von ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], von [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], von [his father], von [Abu Dzar], er sagte; Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, sagte zu me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a schwach Mann, und I lieben für you was I lieben für mich selbst. So tun nicht führen zwei Leute, und tun nicht verwalten the Vermögen von an Waise." Abu Dawud sagte; das hadith was nur narrated by the Leute von Ägypten.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Al Hasan bin Ali], ci ha narrato [Abu Abdurrahman Al Muqri`], ci ha narrato [Sa'id bin Abu Ayyub], da ['Ubaidullah bin Abu Ja'far], da [Salim bin Abu Salim Al Jaisyani], da [his father], da [Abu Dzar], disse; Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, disse a me: "O Abu Dzar, I see you are a debole uomo, e I amare per you cosa I amare per me stesso. So fare non guidare due gente, e fare non amministrare the ricchezza di an orfano." Abu Dawud disse; quello hadith was solo narrated by the gente di Egitto.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ{ إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ }فَكَانَتْ الْوَصِيَّةُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى نَسَخَتْهَا آيَةُ الْمِيرَاثِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], telah menceritakan kepadaku [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], dari [ayahnya], dari [Yazid An Nahwi], dari [Ikrimah] dari [Ibnu Abbas], "Jika ia meninggalkan harta yang banyak, berwasiat untuk ibu-bapak dan karib kerabatnya." Maka wasiat adalah demikian hingga dihapus oleh ayat warisan.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], narrated to me [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], from [his father], from [Yazid An Nahwi], from [Ikrimah] from [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves much wealth, bequeathing to parents and close relatives.' So the will was like that until it was abrogated by the verse of inheritance.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], 私に語った [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], から [his father], から [Yazid An Nahwi], から [Ikrimah] から [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves 多くの 財産, 遺贈すること へ 両親 そして 近い 親族.' So the 遺言 was like その until it was 廃止された by the 節 の 相続.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], 나에게 전했다 [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], 부터 [his father], 부터 [Yazid An Nahwi], 부터 [Ikrimah] 부터 [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves 많은 재산, 유증하는 것 에게 부모 그리고 가까운 친척.' So the 유언 was like 그 until it was 폐지되었다 by the 구절 의 상속.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], 向我讲述 [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], 从 [his father], 从 [Yazid An Nahwi], 从 [Ikrimah] 从 [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves 多 财产, 遗赠 向 父母 和 近 亲戚.' So the 遗嘱 was like 那 until it was 被废止 by the 经文 的 继承.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], m'a raconté [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], de [his father], de [Yazid An Nahwi], de [Ikrimah] de [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves beaucoup richesse, léguer à parents et proches parents.' So the testament was like cela until it was abrogé by the verset de héritage.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], hat mir erzählt [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], von [his father], von [Yazid An Nahwi], von [Ikrimah] von [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves viel Vermögen, vermachen zu Eltern und nahe Verwandte.' So the Testament was like das until it was aufgehoben by the Vers von Erbschaft.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi], mi ha narrato [Ali bin Husain bin Waqid], da [his father], da [Yazid An Nahwi], da [Ikrimah] da [Ibnu Abbas], "'If he leaves molto ricchezza, lasciare in eredità a genitori e stretti parenti.' So the testamento was like quello until it was abrogato by the versetto di eredità.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ نَجْدَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَعْطَى كُلَّ ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ فَلَا وَصِيَّةَ لِوَارِثٍ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], dari [Syurahbil bin Muslim], saya mendengar [Abu Umamah], saya mendengar Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Sesungguhnya Allah telah memberikan hak kepada setiap yang memiliki hak, maka tidak ada wasiat bagi pewaris."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], narrated to us [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], from [Syurahbil bin Muslim], I heard [Abu Umamah], I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, Allah has given every rightful person his right, so there is no will for an heir."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], 私たちに語った [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], から [Syurahbil bin Muslim], 私は聞いた [Abu Umamah], 私は聞いた the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, 言った: "Indeed, アッラー 〜した 与えられた すべての 正当な 人 his 権利, それで そこ is no 遺言 〜のために an 相続人."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], 우리에게 전했다 [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], 부터 [Syurahbil bin Muslim], 나는 들었다 [Abu Umamah], 나는 들었다 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 말했다: "Indeed, 알라 ~했다 주어졌다 모든 정당한 사람 his 권리, 그래서 거기 is no 유언 위해 an 상속인."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], 向我们讲述 [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], 从 [Syurahbil bin Muslim], 我听到 [Abu Umamah], 我听到 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 说: "Indeed, 安拉 已 被给予 每个 有权利的 人 his 权利, 所以 那里 is no 遗嘱 为了 an 继承人."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], nous a raconté [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], de [Syurahbil bin Muslim], J'ai entendu [Abu Umamah], J'ai entendu the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, a dit: "Indeed, Allah a donné chaque ayant droit personne his droit, donc là is no testament pour an héritier."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], hat uns erzählt [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], von [Syurahbil bin Muslim], Ich hörte [Abu Umamah], Ich hörte the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, sagte: "Indeed, Allah hat gegeben jeder berechtigt Person his Recht, also dort is no Testament für an Erbe."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Abdul Wahhab bin Najdah], ci ha narrato [Ibnu 'Ayyasy], da [Syurahbil bin Muslim], Ho sentito [Abu Umamah], Ho sentito the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, disse: "Indeed, Allah ha dato ogni avente diritto persona his diritto, quindi lì is no testamento per an erede."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَلَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ{ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ }وَ{ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ الْيَتَامَى ظُلْمًا }الْآيَةَ انْطَلَقَ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ يَتِيمٌ فَعَزَلَ طَعَامَهُ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ وَشَرَابَهُ مِنْ شَرَابِهِ فَجَعَلَ يَفْضُلُ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ فَيُحْبَسُ لَهُ حَتَّى يَأْكُلَهُ أَوْ يَفْسُدَ فَاشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ{ وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنْ الْيَتَامَى قُلْ إِصْلَاحٌ لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ وَإِنْ تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ }فَخَلَطُوا طَعَامَهُمْ بِطَعَامِهِ وَشَرَابَهُمْ بِشَرَابِهِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Jarir] dari ['Atho`], dari [Sa'id bin Jubair], dari [Ibnu Abbas], ia berkata; tatkala Allah 'azza wajalla menurunkan ayat: "Dan janganlah kamu dekati harta anak yatim, kecuali dengan cara yang lebih bermanfaat." Dan "Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang memakan harta anak yatim secara zalim….." Maka orang yang memiliki anak yatim pergi dan menjauhkan makanannya makanannya dan minumannya dari minumannya. Maka makanan anak yatim tersebut tersisa kemudian disimpan hingga ia memakannya atau menjadi rusak. Maka hal tersebut terasa berat atas mereka, kemudian mereka meceritakan hal tersebut kepada Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam. Lalu Allah 'azza wajalla menurunkan ayat: "Dan mereka bertanya kepadamu tentang anak yatim, katakalah: "Mengurus urusan mereka secara patut adalah baik, dan jika kamu bergaul dengan mereka, maka mereka adalah saudaramu." Kemudian mereka mencampur makanan mereka dengan makanannya dan minuman mereka dengan minumannya.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], narrated to us [Jarir] from ['Atho`], from [Sa'id bin Jubair], from [Ibnu Abbas], he said; when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down the verse: 'And do not approach the wealth of the orphan, except in a way that is better.' And 'Indeed, those who consume the wealth of orphans unjustly...' Then the one who had an orphan went and separated his food and his drink from his drink. Then the orphan's food remained and was stored until he ate it or it spoiled. Then that felt heavy upon them, then they told that to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down the verse: 'And they ask you about orphans; say: "Managing their affairs properly is good, and if you mix with them, then they are your brothers."' Then they mixed their food with his food and their drink with his drink.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], 私たちに語った [Jarir] から ['Atho`], から [Sa'id bin Jubair], から [Ibnu Abbas], 彼は言った; 〜のとき アッラー, Mighty そして Majestic, 下された the 節: 'And する 〜ない 近づく the 財産 の the 孤児, except 〜に a way その is より良い.' And 'Indeed, those 誰 消費する the 財産 の orphans 不当に...' Then the one 誰 〜した an 孤児 行った そして 分けた his 食べ物 そして his 飲み物 から his 飲み物. Then the 孤児's 食べ物 残った そして was 保管された until he それを食べた または it 腐った. Then その 感じた 重く upon them, それから they 語った その へ the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him. Then アッラー, Mighty そして Majestic, 下された the 節: 'And they 尋ねる you 〜について orphans; say: "Managing their 事柄 適切に is 良い, そして もし you 混ぜる とともに them, それから they are your 兄弟たち."' Then they 混ぜた their 食べ物 とともに his 食べ物 そして their 飲み物 とともに his 飲み物.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], 우리에게 전했다 [Jarir] 부터 ['Atho`], 부터 [Sa'id bin Jubair], 부터 [Ibnu Abbas], 그는 말했다; ~할 때 알라, Mighty 그리고 Majestic, 내려졌다 the 구절: 'And 하다 ~아니다 가까이 가다 the 재산 의 the 고아, except 에 a way 그 is 더 나은.' And 'Indeed, those 누구 먹다 the 재산 의 orphans 부당하게...' Then the one 누구 ~했다 an 고아 갔다 그리고 분리했다 his 음식 그리고 his 음료 부터 his 음료. Then the 고아's 음식 남았다 그리고 was 보관되었다 until he 그것을 먹었다 또는 it 상했다. Then 그 느꼈다 무겁게 upon them, 그러자 they 전했다 그 에게 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him. Then 알라, Mighty 그리고 Majestic, 내려졌다 the 구절: 'And they 묻다 you 에 대해 orphans; say: "Managing their 일 제대로 is 좋은, 그리고 만약 you 섞다 함께 them, 그러자 they are your 형제들."' Then they 섞었다 their 음식 함께 his 음식 그리고 their 음료 함께 his 음료.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], 向我们讲述 [Jarir] 从 ['Atho`], 从 [Sa'id bin Jubair], 从 [Ibnu Abbas], 他说; 当 安拉, Mighty 和 Majestic, 被降示 the 经文: 'And 做 不 接近 the 财产 的 the 孤儿, except 在 a way 那 is 更有利.' And 'Indeed, those 谁 侵吞 the 财产 的 orphans 不义地...' Then the one 谁 已 an 孤儿 去了 和 分开 his 食物 和 his 饮料 从 his 饮料. Then the 孤儿's 食物 剩下 和 was 被保存 until he 吃了它 或 it 变质. Then 那 感到 沉重 upon them, 然后 they 讲述 那 向 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him. Then 安拉, Mighty 和 Majestic, 被降示 the 经文: 'And they 问 you 关于 orphans; say: "Managing their 事务 妥善地 is 好, 和 如果 you 交往 与 them, 然后 they are your 兄弟."' Then they 混合 their 食物 与 his 食物 和 their 饮料 与 his 饮料.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], nous a raconté [Jarir] de ['Atho`], de [Sa'id bin Jubair], de [Ibnu Abbas], il a dit; quand Allah, Mighty et Majestic, descendu the verset: 'And faire pas approcher the richesse de the orphelin, except dans a way cela is meilleur.' And 'Indeed, those qui consommer the richesse de orphans injustement...' Then the one qui avait an orphelin est allé et a séparé his nourriture et his boisson de his boisson. Then the orphelin's nourriture est restée et was conservée until he l'a mangée ou it gâtée. Then cela a ressenti lourd upon them, puis they a raconté cela à the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him. Then Allah, Mighty et Majestic, descendu the verset: 'And they demander you au sujet de orphans; say: "Managing their affaires convenablement is bon, et si you se mêler avec them, puis they are your frères."' Then they ont mélangé their nourriture avec his nourriture et their boisson avec his boisson.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], hat uns erzählt [Jarir] von ['Atho`], von [Sa'id bin Jubair], von [Ibnu Abbas], er sagte; wenn Allah, Mighty und Majestic, herabgesandt the Vers: 'And tun nicht sich nähern the Vermögen von the Waise, except in a way das is besser.' And 'Indeed, those wer verzehren the Vermögen von orphans zu Unrecht...' Then the one wer hatte an Waise ging und trennte his Speise und his Getränk von his Getränk. Then the Waise's Speise blieb übrig und was aufbewahrt until he aß sie oder it verdarb. Then das empfand schwer upon them, dann they erzählte das zu the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him. Then Allah, Mighty und Majestic, herabgesandt the Vers: 'And they fragen you über orphans; say: "Managing their Angelegenheiten ordentlich is gut, und wenn you sich vermischen mit them, dann they are your Brüder."' Then they mischten their Speise mit his Speise und their Getränk mit his Getränk.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah?], ci ha narrato [Jarir] da ['Atho`], da [Sa'id bin Jubair], da [Ibnu Abbas], disse; quando Allah, Mighty e Majestic, rivelato the versetto: 'And fare non avvicinarsi the ricchezza di the orfano, except in a way quello is migliore.' And 'Indeed, those chi mangiare the ricchezza di orphans ingiustamente...' Then the one chi aveva an orfano andò e separò his cibo e his bevanda da his bevanda. Then the orfano's cibo rimase e was conservato until he lo mangiò o it andò a male. Then quello provò pesante upon them, poi they narrò quello a the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him. Then Allah, Mighty e Majestic, rivelato the versetto: 'And they chiedere you riguardo orphans; say: "Managing their affari debitamente is buono, e se you mescolarsi con them, poi they are your fratelli."' Then they mescolarono their cibo con his cibo e their bevanda con his bevanda.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ حَدَّثَهُمْ حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ يَعْنِي الْمُعَلِّمَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِأَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي فَقِيرٌ لَيْسَ لِي شَيْءٌ وَلِي يَتِيمٌ قَالَ فَقَالَ كُلْ مِنْ مَالِ يَتِيمِكَ غَيْرَ مُسْرِفٍ وَلَا مُبَادِرٍ وَلَا مُتَأَثِّلٍ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Humaid bin Mas'adah], bahwa [Khalid bin Al Harits] telah menceritakan kepada mereka; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Husain Al Mu'allim] dari ['Amr bin Syu'aib] dari [ayahnya] dari [kakeknya], bahwa seseorang datang kepada Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam dan berkata; aku adalah orang fakir yang tidak memiliki sesuatupun, sementara aku memiliki anak yatim. Kemudian beliau bersabda: "Makanlah sebagian dari harta anak yatimmu, tetapi janganlah berlebihan, tidak menggunakannya secara mubadzir, dan tidak mengambi harta pokoknya.."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Humaid bin Mas'adah], that [Khalid bin Al Harits] told them; narrated to us [Husain Al Mu'allim] from ['Amr bin Syu'aib] from [his father] from [his grandfather], that a man came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and said; I am a poor man who has nothing, while I have an orphan. Then he said: 'Eat part of your orphan's wealth, but do not be excessive, do not use it wastefully, and do not take the capital.'
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Humaid bin Mas'adah], その [Khalid bin Al Harits] 彼らに語った; 私たちに語った [Husain Al Mu'allim] から ['Amr bin Syu'aib] から [his father] から [his grandfather], その a 男 来た へ the 預言者, 平和 be upon him, そして 言った; I am a 貧しい 男 誰 〜した nothing, 〜の間 I 持つ an 孤児. Then 彼は言った: 'Eat part の your 孤児's 財産, しかし する 〜ない be 過度な, する 〜ない use it 浪費して, そして する 〜ない 取る the 元本.'
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Humaid bin Mas'adah], 그 [Khalid bin Al Harits] 그들에게 전했다; 우리에게 전했다 [Husain Al Mu'allim] 부터 ['Amr bin Syu'aib] 부터 [his father] 부터 [his grandfather], 그 a 남자 왔다 에게 the 예언자, 평화 be upon him, 그리고 말했다; I am a 가난한 남자 누구 ~했다 nothing, ~동안 I 가지다 an 고아. Then 그는 말했다: 'Eat part 의 your 고아's 재산, 그러나 하다 ~아니다 be 과도한, 하다 ~아니다 use it 낭비하며, 그리고 하다 ~아니다 가져가다 the 원금.'
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Humaid bin Mas'adah], 那 [Khalid bin Al Harits] 告诉他们; 向我们讲述 [Husain Al Mu'allim] 从 ['Amr bin Syu'aib] 从 [his father] 从 [his grandfather], 那 a 男人 来到 向 the 先知, 和平 be upon him, 和 说; I am a 贫穷 男人 谁 已 nothing, 当 I 有 an 孤儿. Then 他说: 'Eat part 的 your 孤儿's 财产, 但是 做 不 be 过分, 做 不 use it 浪费地, 和 做 不 拿 the 本金.'
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Humaid bin Mas'adah], cela [Khalid bin Al Harits] leur a raconté; nous a raconté [Husain Al Mu'allim] de ['Amr bin Syu'aib] de [his father] de [his grandfather], cela a homme est venue à the Prophète, paix be upon him, et a dit; I am a pauvre homme qui a nothing, pendant que I avoir an orphelin. Then il a dit: 'Eat part de your orphelin's richesse, mais faire pas be excessif, faire pas use it avec gaspillage, et faire pas prendre the capital.'
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Humaid bin Mas'adah], das [Khalid bin Al Harits] hat ihnen erzählt; hat uns erzählt [Husain Al Mu'allim] von ['Amr bin Syu'aib] von [his father] von [his grandfather], das a Mann kam zu the Prophet, Frieden be upon him, und sagte; I am a arm Mann wer hat nothing, während I haben an Waise. Then er sagte: 'Eat part von your Waise's Vermögen, aber tun nicht be übermäßig, tun nicht use it verschwenderisch, und tun nicht nehmen the Kapital.'
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Humaid bin Mas'adah], quello [Khalid bin Al Harits] ha narrato loro; ci ha narrato [Husain Al Mu'allim] da ['Amr bin Syu'aib] da [his father] da [his grandfather], quello a uomo venne a the Profeta, pace be upon him, e disse; I am a povero uomo chi ha nothing, mentre I avere an orfano. Then disse: 'Eat part di your orfano's ricchezza, ma fare non be eccessivo, fare non use it con spreco, e fare non prendere the capitale.'

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدِينِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُقَيْشٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ شُيُوخًا مِنْ بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَمِنْ خَالِهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍحَفِظْتُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَا يُتْمَ بَعْدَ احْتِلَامٍ وَلَا صُمَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Shalih], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] dari [ayahnya], dari [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] bahwa ia mendengar beberapa syekh dari Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf serta dari pamannya yaitu [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], ia berkata; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] berkata; aku telah hafal dari Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam: "Tidak ada yatim setelah baligh, dan tidak ada sikap diam satu hari hingga malam hari."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Shalih], narrated to us [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] narrated to us [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] from [his father], from [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] that he heard several sheikhs from Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf and from his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], he said; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] said; I memorized from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after puberty, and no silence for a day until night.'
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Shalih], 私たちに語った [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] 私たちに語った [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] から [his father], から [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] その he 聞いた several sheikhs から Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf そして から his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], 彼は言った; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] 言った; I 暗記した から the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after 思春期, そして no 沈黙 〜のために a day until 夜.'
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Shalih], 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] 우리에게 전했다 [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] 부터 [his father], 부터 [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] 그 he 들었다 several sheikhs 부터 Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf 그리고 부터 his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], 그는 말했다; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] 말했다; I 암기했다 부터 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after 사춘기, 그리고 no 침묵 위해 a day until 밤.'
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Shalih], 向我们讲述 [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] 向我们讲述 [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] 从 [his father], 从 [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] 那 he 听到 several sheikhs 从 Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf 和 从 his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], 他说; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] 说; I 记住 从 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after 成年, 和 no 沉默 为了 a day until 夜晚.'
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Shalih], nous a raconté [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] nous a raconté [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] de [his father], de [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] cela he a entendu several sheikhs de Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf et de his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], il a dit; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] a dit; I ai mémorisé de the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after puberté, et no silence pour a day until nuit.'
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Shalih], hat uns erzählt [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] hat uns erzählt [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] von [his father], von [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] das he hörte several sheikhs von Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf und von his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], er sagte; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] sagte; I habe auswendig gelernt von the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after Pubertät, und no Schweigen für a day until Nacht.'
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Shalih], ci ha narrato [Yahya bin Muhammad Al Madini] ci ha narrato [Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sa'id bin Abu Maryam] da [his father], da [Sa'id bin Abdurrahman bin Yazid bin Ruqaisy] quello he sentì several sheikhs da Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf e da his uncle, namely [Abdullah bin Abu Ahmad], disse; [Ali bin Abu Thalib] disse; I ho memorizzato da the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him: 'There is no orphanhood after pubertà, e no silenzio per a day until notte.'

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلَالٍ عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ اجْتَنِبُوا السَّبْعَ الْمُوبِقَاتِ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا هُنَّ قَالَ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ وَالسِّحْرُ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْلُ الرِّبَا وَأَكْلُ مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ وَالتَّوَلِّي يَوْمَ الزَّحْفِ وَقَذْفُ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد أَبُو الْغَيْثِ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى ابْنِ مُطِيعٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْجُوْزَجَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الْكَبَائِرُ فَقَالَ هُنَّ تِسْعٌ فَذَكَرَ مَعْنَاهُ زَادَ وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ الْمُسْلِمَيْنِ وَاسْتِحْلَالُ الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ قِبْلَتِكُمْ أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ibnu Wahb] dari [Sulaiman bin Bilal] dari [Tsaur bin Zaid] dari [Abu Al Ghaits] dari [Abu Hurairah], bahwa Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Jauhilah tujuh perkara yang membinasakan!" Beliau ditanya; wahai Rasulullah, apakah perkara tersebut? Beliau berkata: ""Mensekutukan Allah, sihir, membunuh jiwa yang Allah haramkan kecuali dengan haq, memakan riba, memakan harta anak yatim, lari dari peperangan, menuduh seorang wanita mukmin yang suci dan baik berbuat zina." Abu Daud berkata; Abu Al Ghaits Salim adalah mantan budak Ibnu Muthi'. Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Mu'adz bin Hani`], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Harb bin Syaddad], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], dari [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] dari ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], dari [ayahnya], bahwa ia telah menceritakan kepadanya, dan ia pernah menyertai Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam. Bahwa seorang laki-laki pernah bertanya kepada Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam, ia berkata; wahai Rasulullah, apakah dosa-dosa besar itu? Kemudian beliau berkata: "Dosa-dosa besar tersebut ada sembilan." Kemudian ia menyebutkan maknanya, dan ia tambahkan; dan durhaka kepada kedua orang tua muslim, dan menghalalkan hal-hal yang haram dilakukan di Baitul Haram kiblat kalian (seperti berburu, memotoh pepohonan), baik yang hidup maupun yang mati.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], narrated to us [Ibnu Wahb] from [Sulaiman bin Bilal] from [Tsaur bin Zaid] from [Abu Al Ghaits] from [Abu Hurairah], that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "'Avoid seven destructive things!' He was asked; O Messenger of Allah, what are those things? He said: 'Associating partners with Allah, magic, killing a soul that Allah has forbidden except by right, consuming usury, consuming the wealth of an orphan, fleeing from battle, accusing a chaste, good believing woman of adultery.' Abu Dawud said; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the former slave of Ibnu Muthi'. Narrated to us [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], narrated to us [Mu'adz bin Hani`], narrated to us [Harb bin Syaddad], narrated to us [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], from [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] from ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], from [his father], that he told him, and he once accompanied The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. Bahwa a man asked the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said; O Messenger of Allah, what are the major sins? Then he said: 'The major sins are nine.' Then he mentioned its meaning, and he added; and disobedience to two Muslim parents, and permitting what is forbidden to do in the Sacred House, your qiblah (such as hunting, cutting trees), whether alive or dead.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], 私たちに語った [Ibnu Wahb] から [Sulaiman bin Bilal] から [Tsaur bin Zaid] から [Abu Al Ghaits] から [Abu Hurairah], その the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, 言った: "'Avoid 七つ 破壊的な things!' He was 尋ねられた; O 使徒 の アッラー, 何 are those things? 彼は言った: 'Associating partners とともに アッラー, 魔法, 殺すこと a 魂 その アッラー 〜した 禁じられた except by 権利, 消費すること 利子, 消費すること the 財産 の an 孤児, 逃げること から 戦闘, 告発すること a 貞淑な, 良い 信仰する 女性 の 姦通.' アブー・ダーウードは言った; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the 元 奴隷 の Ibnu Muthi'. 私たちに語った [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], 私たちに語った [Mu'adz bin Hani`], 私たちに語った [Harb bin Syaddad], 私たちに語った [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], から [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] から ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], から [his father], その he 彼に語った, そして he かつて 同行した アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）. Bahwa a 男 尋ねられた the 預言者, 平和 be upon him, 彼は言った; O 使徒 の アッラー, 何 are the 大 罪? Then 彼は言った: 'The 大 罪 are 九つ.' Then he 述べた its 意味, そして he 付け加えた; そして 反抗 へ 二 ムスリム 両親, そして 許可すること 何 is 禁じられた へ する 〜に the 神聖な館, your キブラ (such as 狩猟, 切ること 木), whether 生きている または 死んだ.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], 우리에게 전했다 [Ibnu Wahb] 부터 [Sulaiman bin Bilal] 부터 [Tsaur bin Zaid] 부터 [Abu Al Ghaits] 부터 [Abu Hurairah], 그 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 말했다: "'Avoid 일곱 파멸적인 things!' He was 물었다; O 메신저 의 알라, 무엇 are those things? 그는 말했다: 'Associating partners 함께 알라, 마술, 죽이는 것 a 영혼 그 알라 ~했다 금지된 except by 권리, 먹는 것 고리대금, 먹는 것 the 재산 의 an 고아, 도망치는 것 부터 전투, 고발하는 것 a 정숙한, 좋은 믿는 여성 의 간음.' 아부 다우드가 말했다; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the 전 노예 의 Ibnu Muthi'. 우리에게 전했다 [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], 우리에게 전했다 [Mu'adz bin Hani`], 우리에게 전했다 [Harb bin Syaddad], 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], 부터 [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] 부터 ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], 부터 [his father], 그 he 그에게 전했다, 그리고 he 한 번 동행했다 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를). Bahwa a 남자 물었다 the 예언자, 평화 be upon him, 그는 말했다; O 메신저 의 알라, 무엇 are the 큰 죄? Then 그는 말했다: 'The 큰 죄 are 아홉.' Then he 언급했다 its 의미, 그리고 he 추가했다; 그리고 불순종 에게 둘 무슬림 부모, 그리고 허용하는 것 무엇 is 금지된 에게 하다 에 the 신성한 집, your 키블라 (such as 사냥, 베는 것 나무), whether 살아 있는 또는 죽은.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], 向我们讲述 [Ibnu Wahb] 从 [Sulaiman bin Bilal] 从 [Tsaur bin Zaid] 从 [Abu Al Ghaits] 从 [Abu Hurairah], 那 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 说: "'Avoid 七 毁灭性 things!' He was 被问; O 使者 的 安拉, 什么 are those things? 他说: 'Associating partners 与 安拉, 巫术, 杀害 a 灵魂 那 安拉 已 被禁止 except by 权利, 侵吞 利息, 侵吞 the 财产 的 an 孤儿, 逃离 从 战斗, 诬告 a 贞洁, 好 信仰 妇女 的 通奸.' 艾布·达乌德说; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the 以前的 奴隶 的 Ibnu Muthi'. 向我们讲述 [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], 向我们讲述 [Mu'adz bin Hani`], 向我们讲述 [Harb bin Syaddad], 向我们讲述 [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], 从 [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] 从 ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], 从 [his father], 那 he 告诉他, 和 he 一次 陪伴 安拉的使者（愿他平安）. Bahwa a 男人 被问 the 先知, 和平 be upon him, 他说; O 使者 的 安拉, 什么 are the 大 大罪? Then 他说: 'The 大 大罪 are 九.' Then he 提到 its 含义, 和 he 补充; 和 忤逆 向 二 穆斯林 父母, 和 允许 什么 is 被禁止 向 做 在 the 禁寺, your 朝向 (such as 狩猎, 砍伐 树木), whether 活着 或 死的.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], nous a raconté [Ibnu Wahb] de [Sulaiman bin Bilal] de [Tsaur bin Zaid] de [Abu Al Ghaits] de [Abu Hurairah], cela the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, a dit: "'Avoid sept destructrices things!' He was interrogé; O Messager de Allah, quoi are those things? Il a dit: 'Associating partners avec Allah, magie, tuer a âme cela Allah a interdite except by droit, consommer usure, consommer the richesse de an orphelin, fuir de bataille, accuser a chaste, bon croyante femme de adultère.' Abou Dawoud a dit; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the ancien esclave de Ibnu Muthi'. Nous a raconté [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], nous a raconté [Mu'adz bin Hani`], nous a raconté [Harb bin Syaddad], nous a raconté [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], de [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] de ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], de [his father], cela he lui a raconté, et he une fois a accompagné Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui. Bahwa a homme interrogé the Prophète, paix be upon him, il a dit; O Messager de Allah, quoi are the majeurs péchés? Then il a dit: 'The majeurs péchés are neuf.' Then he a mentionné its sens, et he a ajouté; et désobéissance à deux musulman parents, et rendre licite quoi is interdite à faire dans the Maison Sacrée, your qibla (such as chasse, couper arbres), whether vivant ou mort.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], hat uns erzählt [Ibnu Wahb] von [Sulaiman bin Bilal] von [Tsaur bin Zaid] von [Abu Al Ghaits] von [Abu Hurairah], das the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, sagte: "'Avoid sieben zerstörend things!' He was gefragt; O Gesandter von Allah, was are those things? Er sagte: 'Associating partners mit Allah, Zauberei, Töten a Seele das Allah hat verboten except by Recht, Verzehren Zins, Verzehren the Vermögen von an Waise, Fliehen von Schlacht, Beschuldigen a keusch, gut gläubig Frau von Ehebruch.' Abu Dawud sagte; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the ehemalig Sklave von Ibnu Muthi'. Hat uns erzählt [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], hat uns erzählt [Mu'adz bin Hani`], hat uns erzählt [Harb bin Syaddad], hat uns erzählt [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], von [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] von ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], von [his father], das he hat ihm erzählt, und he einmal begleitete Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm. Bahwa a Mann gefragt the Prophet, Frieden be upon him, er sagte; O Gesandter von Allah, was are the groß Sünden? Then er sagte: 'The groß Sünden are neun.' Then he erwähnte its Bedeutung, und he fügte hinzu; und Ungehorsam zu zwei Muslim Eltern, und Erlauben was is verboten zu tun in the Heiliges Haus, your Qibla (such as Jagen, Fällen Bäume), whether lebendig oder tot.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Sa'id Al Hamdani], ci ha narrato [Ibnu Wahb] da [Sulaiman bin Bilal] da [Tsaur bin Zaid] da [Abu Al Ghaits] da [Abu Hurairah], quello the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, disse: "'Avoid sette distruttive things!' He was interrogato; O Messaggero di Allah, cosa are those things? Disse: 'Associating partners con Allah, magia, uccidere a anima quello Allah ha proibita except by diritto, mangiare usura, mangiare the ricchezza di an orfano, fuggire da battaglia, accusare a casta, buono credente donna di adulterio.' Abu Dawud disse; Abu Al Ghaits Salim is the ex schiavo di Ibnu Muthi'. Ci ha narrato [Ibrahim bin Ya'qub Al Juzajani], ci ha narrato [Mu'adz bin Hani`], ci ha narrato [Harb bin Syaddad], ci ha narrato [Yahya bin Abu Katsir], da [Abdul Hamid bin Sinan] da ['Ubaid bin 'Umair], da [his father], quello he gli ha narrato, e he una volta accompagnò Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui. Bahwa a uomo interrogato the Profeta, pace be upon him, disse; O Messaggero di Allah, cosa are the gravi peccati? Then disse: 'The gravi peccati are nove.' Then he menzionò its significato, e he aggiunse; e disobbedienza a due musulmano genitori, e rendere lecito cosa is proibita a fare in the Casa Sacra, your qibla (such as caccia, tagliare alberi), whether vivo o morto.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ خَبَّابٍ قَالَمُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ إِلَّا نَمِرَةٌ كُنَّا إِذَا غَطَّيْنَا بِهَا رَأْسَهُ خَرَجَتْ رِجْلَاهُ وَإِذَا غَطَّيْنَا رِجْلَيْهِ خَرَجَ رَأْسُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ غَطُّوا بِهَا رَأْسَهُ وَاجْعَلُوا عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ مِنْ الْإِذْخِرِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Muhammad bin Katsir], telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Sufyan] dari [Al A'masy] dari [Abu Wail], dari [Khabbab], ia berkata; Mush'ab bin 'Umair telah terbunuh pada saat perang Uhud, dan ia hanya memiliki sehelai kain, apabila kami menutup kepalanya maka kedua kakinya keluar, dan apabila kami tutup kedua kakinya maka keluar kepalanya. Kemudian Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Tutuplah kepalanya menggunakan kain tersebut dan letakkan idzkhir di atas kedua kakinya!"
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Muhammad bin Katsir], informed us [Sufyan] from [Al A'masy] from [Abu Wail], from [Khabbab], he said; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was killed at the Battle of Uhud, and he only had a single cloth; if we covered his head, his two feet came out, and if we covered his two feet, his head came out. Then the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Cover his head with that cloth and place idzkhir over his two feet!'
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Muhammad bin Katsir], 私たちに伝えた [Sufyan] から [Al A'masy] から [Abu Wail], から [Khabbab], 彼は言った; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was 殺された at the 戦い の ウフド, そして he ただ 〜した a 一枚の 布; もし we 覆った his 頭, his 二 足 出た, そして もし we 覆った his 二 足, his 頭 出た. Then the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, 言った: 'Cover his 頭 とともに その 布 そして 置く イズヒル 〜の上に his 二 足!'
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Muhammad bin Katsir], 우리에게 알려 주었다 [Sufyan] 부터 [Al A'masy] 부터 [Abu Wail], 부터 [Khabbab], 그는 말했다; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was 죽였다 at the 전투 의 우후드, 그리고 he 다만 ~했다 a 한 장의 천; 만약 we 덮었다 his 머리, his 둘 발 나왔다, 그리고 만약 we 덮었다 his 둘 발, his 머리 나왔다. Then the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 말했다: 'Cover his 머리 함께 그 천 그리고 놓다 이즈히르 위에 his 둘 발!'
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Muhammad bin Katsir], 告诉我们 [Sufyan] 从 [Al A'masy] 从 [Abu Wail], 从 [Khabbab], 他说; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was 被杀 at the 战役 的 吴侯德, 和 he 只 已 a 一件 布; 如果 we 盖住 his 头, his 二 脚 露出, 和 如果 we 盖住 his 二 脚, his 头 露出. Then the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 说: 'Cover his 头 与 那 布 和 放 香茅 在~上 his 二 脚!'
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Muhammad bin Katsir], nous a informés [Sufyan] de [Al A'masy] de [Abu Wail], de [Khabbab], il a dit; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was a été tué at the bataille de Uhud, et he seulement avait a un seul tissu; si we avons couvert his tête, his deux pieds sortaient, et si we avons couvert his deux pieds, his tête sortaient. Then the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, a dit: 'Cover his tête avec cela tissu et placer idzkhir sur his deux pieds!'
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Muhammad bin Katsir], hat uns berichtet [Sufyan] von [Al A'masy] von [Abu Wail], von [Khabbab], er sagte; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was getötet at the Schlacht von Uhud, und he nur hatte a ein einziges Tuch; wenn we bedeckten his Kopf, his zwei Füße herauskamen, und wenn we bedeckten his zwei Füße, his Kopf herauskamen. Then the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, sagte: 'Cover his Kopf mit das Tuch und legen Idzkhir über his zwei Füße!'
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Muhammad bin Katsir], ci ha informato [Sufyan] da [Al A'masy] da [Abu Wail], da [Khabbab], disse; Mush'ab bin 'Umair was fu ucciso at the battaglia di Uhud, e he solo aveva a un solo panno; se we coprimmo his testa, his due piedi uscivano, e se we coprimmo his due piedi, his testa uscivano. Then the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, disse: 'Cover his testa con quello panno e mettere idzkhir sopra his due piedi!'

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بَنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ بُرَيْدَةَأَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ تَصَدَّقْتُ عَلَى أُمِّي بِوَلِيدَةٍ وَإِنَّهَا مَاتَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ تِلْكَ الْوَلِيدَةَ قَالَ قَدْ وَجَبَ أَجْرُكِ وَرَجَعَتْ إِلَيْكِ فِي الْمِيرَاثِ قَالَتْ وَإِنَّهَا مَاتَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا صَوْمُ شَهْرٍ أَفَيُجْزِئُ أَوْ يَقْضِي عَنْهَا أَنْ أَصُومَ عَنْهَا قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَتْ وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَحُجَّ أَفَيُجْزِئُ أَوْ يَقْضِي عَنْهَا أَنْ أَحُجَّ عَنْهَا قَالَ نَعَمْ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Yunus], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Zuhair], telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], dari [Abdullah bin Buraidah], dari [ayahnya], bahwa seorang wanita datang kepada Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam dan berkata; dahulu aku bersedekah kepada ibuku dengan memberikan seorang budak wanita, dan beliau meninggal serta meninggalkan budak tersebut. Beliau berkata: "Telah tetap pahalamu dan budak tersebut kembali kepadamu diantara harta warisan." Wanita tersebut berkata; beliau meninggal dalam keadaan memiliki kewajiban berpuasa satu bulan. Apakah sah atau dapat menunaikan untuknya apabila aku berpuasa untuknya? Beliau berkata: "Ya." Wanita tersebtu berkata; sesungguhnya beliau belum berhaji, apakah sah atau dapat menunaikan untuknya apabila aku berhaji untuknya? Beliau berkata: "Ya."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Yunus], narrated to us [Zuhair], narrated to us [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], from [Abdullah bin Buraidah], from [his father], that a woman came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and said; I once gave charity to my mother by giving a female slave, and she died leaving that slave. He said: 'Your reward has been established, and that slave has returned to you among the inheritance.' The woman said; she died having an obligation to fast one month. Is it valid or can I fulfil it for her if I fast for her? He said: 'Yes.' The woman said; indeed she has not performed Hajj; is it valid or can I fulfil it for her if I perform Hajj for her? He said: 'Yes.'
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Yunus], 私たちに語った [Zuhair], 私たちに語った [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], から [Abdullah bin Buraidah], から [his father], その a 女性 来た へ the 使徒 の アッラー, 平和 be upon him, そして 言った; I かつて 与えた 施し へ my 母 by 与えること a 女奴隷, そして she 死んだ leaving その 奴隷. 彼は言った: 'Your 報奨 〜した been 確定した, そして その 奴隷 〜した 戻った へ you 〜の中で the 相続.' The 女性 言った; she 死んだ having an 義務 へ 断食する one 月. Is it 有効な または できる I 果たす it 〜のために her もし I 断食する 〜のために her? 彼は言った: 'Yes.' The 女性 言った; indeed she 〜した 〜ない performed Hajj; is it 有効な または できる I 果たす it 〜のために her もし I ハッジを行う 〜のために her? 彼は言った: 'Yes.'
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Yunus], 우리에게 전했다 [Zuhair], 우리에게 전했다 [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], 부터 [Abdullah bin Buraidah], 부터 [his father], 그 a 여성 왔다 에게 the 메신저 의 알라, 평화 be upon him, 그리고 말했다; I 한 번 주었다 자선 에게 my 어머니 by 주는 것 a 여노예, 그리고 she 죽었다 leaving 그 노예. 그는 말했다: 'Your 보상 ~했다 been 확립되었다, 그리고 그 노예 ~했다 돌아왔다 에게 you 중에서 the 상속.' The 여성 말했다; she 죽었다 having an 의무 에게 단식하다 one 달. Is it 유효한 또는 할 수 있다 I 이행하다 it 위해 her 만약 I 단식하다 위해 her? 그는 말했다: 'Yes.' The 여성 말했다; indeed she ~했다 ~아니다 performed Hajj; is it 유효한 또는 할 수 있다 I 이행하다 it 위해 her 만약 I 하지를 수행하다 위해 her? 그는 말했다: 'Yes.'
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Yunus], 向我们讲述 [Zuhair], 向我们讲述 [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], 从 [Abdullah bin Buraidah], 从 [his father], 那 a 妇女 来到 向 the 使者 的 安拉, 和平 be upon him, 和 说; I 一次 给予 施舍 向 my 母亲 by 给予 a 女奴, 和 she 去世 leaving 那 奴隶. 他说: 'Your 报酬 已 been 已确定, 和 那 奴隶 已 回到 向 you 在~中 the 继承.' The 妇女 说; she 去世 having an 义务 向 封斋 one 月. Is it 有效 或 可以 I 履行 it 为了 her 如果 I 封斋 为了 her? 他说: 'Yes.' The 妇女 说; indeed she 已 不 performed Hajj; is it 有效 或 可以 I 履行 it 为了 her 如果 I 朝觐 为了 her? 他说: 'Yes.'
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Yunus], nous a raconté [Zuhair], nous a raconté [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], de [Abdullah bin Buraidah], de [his father], cela a femme est venue à the Messager de Allah, paix be upon him, et a dit; I une fois a donné aumône à my mère by donner a esclave femme, et she est mort leaving cela esclave. Il a dit: 'Your récompense a been a été confirmé, et cela esclave a est retournée à you parmi the héritage.' The femme a dit; she est mort having an obligation à jeûner one mois. Is it valide ou peut I accomplir it pour her si I jeûner pour her? Il a dit: 'Yes.' The femme a dit; indeed she a pas performed Hajj; is it valide ou peut I accomplir it pour her si I accomplir le Hajj pour her? Il a dit: 'Yes.'
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Yunus], hat uns erzählt [Zuhair], hat uns erzählt [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], von [Abdullah bin Buraidah], von [his father], das a Frau kam zu the Gesandter von Allah, Frieden be upon him, und sagte; I einmal gab Almosen zu my Mutter by Geben a Sklavin, und she starb leaving das Sklave. Er sagte: 'Your Belohnung hat been festgestellt, und das Sklave hat kehrte zurück zu you unter the Erbschaft.' The Frau sagte; she starb having an Verpflichtung zu fasten one Monat. Is it gültig oder kann I erfüllen it für her wenn I fasten für her? Er sagte: 'Yes.' The Frau sagte; indeed she hat nicht performed Hajj; is it gültig oder kann I erfüllen it für her wenn I Haddsch vollziehen für her? Er sagte: 'Yes.'
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Yunus], ci ha narrato [Zuhair], ci ha narrato [Abdullah bin 'Atha`], da [Abdullah bin Buraidah], da [his father], quello a donna venne a the Messaggero di Allah, pace be upon him, e disse; I una volta diede elemosina a my madre by dare a schiava, e she morì leaving quello schiavo. Disse: 'Your ricompensa ha been è stato confermato, e quello schiavo ha tornò a you tra the eredità.' The donna disse; she morì having an obbligo a digiunare one mese. Is it valido o può I adempiere it per her se I digiunare per her? Disse: 'Yes.' The donna disse; indeed she ha non performed Hajj; is it valido o può I adempiere it per her se I compiere l'Hajj per her? Disse: 'Yes.'

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ ح و حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ ح و حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَأَصَابَ عُمَرُ أَرْضًا بِخَيْبَرَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ أَصَبْتُ أَرْضًا لَمْ أُصِبْ مَالًا قَطُّ أَنْفَسَ عِنْدِي مِنْهُ فَكَيْفَ تَأْمُرُنِي بِهِ قَالَ إِنْ شِئْتَ حَبَّسْتَ أَصْلَهَا وَتَصَدَّقْتَ بِهَا فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهَا عُمَرُ أَنَّهُ لَا يُبَاعُ أَصْلُهَا وَلَا يُوهَبُ وَلَا يُوَرَّثُ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ وَالْقُرْبَى وَالرِّقَابِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَزَادَ عَنْ بِشْرٍ وَالضَّيْفِ ثُمَّ اتَّفَقُوا لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهَا أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيُطْعِمَ صَدِيقًا غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ فِيهِ زَادَ عَنْ بِشْرٍ قَالَ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ غَيْرَ مُتَأَثِّلٍ مَالًاحَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بِنُ دَاوُدَ الْمَهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَدَقَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ نَسَخَهَا لِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ هَذَا مَا كَتَبَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عُمَرُ فِي ثَمْغٍ فَقَصَّ مِنْ خَبَرِهِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ نَافِعٍ قَالَ غَيْرَ مُتَأَثِّلٍ مَالًا فَمَا عَفَا عَنْهُ مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ فَهُوَ لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ قَالَ وَسَاقَ الْقِصَّةَ قَالَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ وَلِيُّ ثَمْغٍ اشْتَرَى مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ رَقِيقًا لِعَمَلِهِ وَكَتَبَ مُعَيْقِيبٌ وَشَهِدَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْأَرْقَمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ هَذَا مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عُمَرُ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ أَنَّ ثَمْغًا وَصِرْمَةَ بْنَ الْأَكْوَعِ وَالْعَبْدَ الَّذِي فِيهِ وَالْمِائَةَ سَهْمٍ الَّتِي بِخَيْبَرَ وَرَقِيقَهُ الَّذِي فِيهِ وَالْمِائَةَ الَّتِي أَطْعَمَهُ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْوَادِي تَلِيهِ حَفْصَةُ مَا عَاشَتْ ثُمَّ يَلِيهِ ذُو الرَّأْيِ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا أَنْ لَا يُبَاعَ وَلَا يُشْتَرَى يُنْفِقُهُ حَيْثُ رَأَى مِنْ السَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ وَذَوِي الْقُرْبَى وَلَا حَرَجَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهُ إِنْ أَكَلَ أَوْ آكَلَ أَوْ اشْتَرَى رَقِيقًا مِنْهُ
